target_customer: Mid-market and enterprise operations teams, especially promo, print and apparel distributors, suppliers and decorators
problem: Back-office work such as purchase order entry, invoice matching and order follow-ups is manual and spread across tools without APIs.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform for building AI agents, hosted tiers not found

founders.name: Abhimanyu Yadav
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education.

founders.name: Ritanshu Dokania
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education.

competitors.name: Stablein Solutions
competitors.what: Automation for promo suppliers and distributors, artwork processing and data entry

competitors.name: Conexiom
competitors.what: AI order and invoice processing for distributors and manufacturers

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent builder with browser agents for non-API systems, approvals and on-prem deployment is substantial but based on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: General agent platforms are easy to replicate; vertical workflow depth in promo and apparel could create switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: WizCommerce launched an AI order entry tool in June 2026 per Distribution Strategy, after the batch.

market_need_then: Distributors in promotional products described using AI automation for order entry in a September 2025 ASI article; manual order work was a known pain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain English agent building; execution layer for operational workflows

rebrands.why: Moved from AI agents for B2B inbound sales to back-office workflow agents, per YC page; exact date not stated

branding.community_and_virality: Listed in PPAI directory for promo suppliers; no fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is new after a rename and similar to Trillium and Thelium names; little brand coverage.

pivots.from: AI agents for B2B inbound sales (Questom)
pivots.to: AI agents for enterprise back-office operations (Trelium)
pivots.why: Not stated; YC page notes the rebrand from Questom

outcome_analysis: Trelium joined YC in Fall 2025 after rebranding from Questom and shifting from sales agents to back-office operations for promo and apparel firms. Its site lists seven customers, and the YC page lists a team of eleven. No exit or shutdown was found, funding is only a CB Insights convertible note estimate, and the outcome remains open.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights lists a convertible note of about $500K with YC; Standout calls it seed. Stage not stated by a primary source. Team size shown as 2 on aggregators and 11 on the YC page. Competitor sources are undated. Completeness pass: a 500K round is recorded from CB Insights (convertible note); VCBacked lists the same 500K as Pre-Seed in December 2025 under the former name Questom. Stage is other because sources disagree; it rests on databases only.
